== Biography ==
Elizabeth Glasgow was recorded at Polwarth, Berwickshire, on 17 August 1656. The FamilySearch index names her father as William Glasgow.<ref name="ElizabethPolwarth">“Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,” FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XYL3-24Q : accessed 16 September 2021), Elizabeth Glasgow, Polwarth, 17 August 1656.</ref>

She was probably the Elizabeth Glasgow entered in the Polwarth deaths and burials index on 16 March 1657, about seven months later. The index gives neither age nor relatives, so the identification rests on name, parish and chronology rather than an explicit family statement.<ref name="ElizabethBurial">National Records of Scotland, Old Parish Registers, deaths and burials, Polwarth, parish 754, reference 10/30, 16 March 1657, Elizabeth Glasgow; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ Scotland's People], exact-surname Glasgow search to 1700, index extract supplied 10 September 2026. Other details blank; age blank; gender F. Original image not inspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2462]] is assessed at 41% (possible). Elizabeth's Polwarth index event of 17 August 1656 names father William Glasgow. The selected William’s 1639 birth would permit the 1656 Polwarth father role at sixteen or seventeen, but that young age and the Inveresk-to-Polwarth move need a positive identification.

Possible fatherhood specifically for William-2462; the index’s named father William is secure, but it does not identify his childhood.

Next useful test: Find an adult William marriage or residence bridge before preferring the 1639 child more strongly.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XYL3-24Q FamilySearch, Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950: Elizabeth Glasgow, baptised 17 August 1656 at Polwarth, father William Glasgow, record XYL3-24Q (); William Glasgow, baptised 4 April 1658 at Polwarth, father William Glasgow, record XTBH-RJS]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The 1656 index names Elizabeth's father only as William Glasgow. It does not identify him with [[Glasgow-2462|William Glasgow]], whose own record is at Inveresk and whose profile supplies no documented move to Polwarth. That father link remains uncertain pending the original parish entry or another identity bridge.

The 1657 entry is a probable match, not proof that the child died on that exact day. Check the original OPR 754/10/30 entry for a parent, age or residence and for whether the date denotes death, burial or another burial-related entry. Another woman of the same name has not been excluded by a positive identifying detail.
